title: Structural Connectivity Between the Zinc Linchpin Motif, the [4Fe-4S] cluster, and the active site orchestrates DNA repair in MUTYH
authors: Mohammad Hashemian; Melody Malek; Tian Xia; April Lu; Alam X. León-Cardona; Andrew Fisher; Carlos H. Trasviña-Arenas; Sheila S. David
one_liner_zh: 该文通过晶体结构解析MUTYH-DNA复合物，揭示Zn与Fe-S簇协同调控DNA修复的构象机制，属广义蛋白-DNA互作的结构机理研究，但无AI/物理模拟方法，且非TF-DNA体系，故为中档。
abstract: The DNA glycosylase MUTYH protects genomic integrity by excising adenine mispaired with 8-oxoguanine (OG), which initiates base excision repair (BER). The [4Fe-4S] cluster DNA binding domain and Zn linchpin motif of MUTYH are hotspots for inherited cancer associated variants (CAVs) highlighting their critical functions in DNA repair. Here, we present three full-length human MUTYH crystal structures bound to DNA across three catalytic states, representing early and late transition states and product complexes. These structures reveal a previously unrecognized interplay between the Zn site and the Fe–S cluster mediated by His85 and a conserved Arg247/Arg307 bridge spanning ∼15 Å. Disruption of this network impairs metal loading, reduces the active enzyme fraction, weakens lesion DNA binding, and diminishes OG:A repair in cells. Moreover, the Zn site adopts distinct coordination modes across the reaction coordinate, with a water molecule replacing a cysteine ligand in transition state analog complexes and cysteine coordination restored in a product-mimicked state. Functional analyses show that this ligand switching is dispensable for core glycosylase chemistry in vitro but disproportionately affects repair in cells, suggesting an additional role of the Zn linchpin in cellular OG:A repair beyond intrinsic glycosylase activity, likely involving interactions with BER partners. Together, these findings illustrate how the Zn linchpin enhances Fe–S cluster domain DNA substrate engagement to enable effective DNA repair and provides a rationale for how these functions are compromised by MUTYH CAVs.
abstract_zh: DNA糖苷酶MUTYH通过切除与8-氧代鸟嘌呤（OG）错配的腺嘌呤来保护基因组完整性，从而启动碱基切除修复（BER）。MUTYH的[4Fe-4S]簇DNA结合结构域和Zn锚定基序是遗传性癌症相关变异（CAVs）的热点区域，突显了它们在DNA修复中的关键功能。在此，我们展示了三种全长人MUTYH晶体结构，它们与DNA结合并跨越三个催化状态，代表早期和晚期过渡态及产物复合物。这些结构揭示了Zn位点与Fe–S簇之间通过His85和保守的Arg247/Arg307桥（跨越约15 Å）介导的先前未被识别的相互作用。破坏这一网络会损害金属负载，降低活性酶比例，削弱病变DNA结合，并减少细胞中的OG:A修复。此外，Zn位点在反应坐标上采用不同的配位模式，在过渡态类似物复合物中，一个水分子取代半胱氨酸配体，而在产物模拟状态中，半胱氨酸配位得以恢复。功能分析表明，这种配体切换在体外对核心糖苷酶化学活性并非必需，但对细胞中的修复影响不成比例，提示Zn锚定基序在细胞OG:A修复中具有超出内在糖苷酶活性的额外作用，可能涉及与BER伙伴的相互作用。综合来看，这些发现阐明了Zn锚定基序如何增强Fe–S簇结构域的DNA底物结合以实现有效DNA修复，并为MUTYH CAVs如何损害这些功能提供了机制解释。
